title: Helix Survival
description: Originally started as Hexasis Survival, it turned into its own separate thing with custom mods and a unique community.
body:
Helix Survival is the reason I started making Minecraft mods. Initially with the dream of making a massive multiplayer online survival, we decided to keep it a smaller casual server.

_Some links to check out;_
- [Our main site](https://hexasis.eu/helix)
- [Our mod list](https://hexasis.eu/helix#mods)
- [Our webmap](https://map.hexasis.eu)

> Interested in joining? Join our [Discord](https://hexasis.eu/dc/helix) to submit a Whitelist Request!
